mapper.select: select c1.c_name as pdCompanyName, sd.d_name as pdDepartmentName, mn.* from Progress_Declaration mn left join sys_company c1 on c1.c_id=mn.pd_company left join sys_department sd on sd.d_id=mn.pd_department where mn.id=#{id}

select pddtl.* from Progress_Declaration_Dtl pddtl left join Progress_Declaration pd on pd.id = pddtl.Pd_id
pd.state = 7
and pddtl.con_id=#{conId}
order by state_time desc limit 1

select con.con_id as conId, con.con_name as conName, con.con_Code as conCode, con.con_Money_Total as conMoneyTotal, pre.p_id as pId, pre.p_name as pName from con_contract con left join pre_project pre on con.Con_Project_Id = pre.P_ID
con.Con_Approval_State = 7 and pre.State = 7
and con.con_Department=#{dto.cId}
and con.con_name like concat('%',#{dto.conName},'%')
and likePname(#{dto.pName},pre.P_Id)=true
and pre.pName like concat('%',#{dto.pName},'%')
